```{julia}
"""
    state_matrix(df, epoch; valuecol=:accuracies, fill=NaN)

Return a (n_bees × n_tasks) Matrix of accuracies for the given epoch.
Rows correspond to bee_id, columns to task_id.

Also returns (bee_ids, task_ids) so you know the ordering.
"""
function state_matrix(df::DataFrame, epoch::Integer; valuecol::Symbol=:accuracies, fill=NaN)
    sdf = @view df[df.epoch .== epoch, :]
    isempty(sdf) && throw(ArgumentError("No rows found for epoch=$epoch"))

    wide = unstack(DataFrame(sdf), :bee_id, :task_id, valuecol; fill=fill)

    bee_ids = wide.bee_id
    task_ids = names(wide)[2:end] .|> x -> parse(Int, String(x))  # columns are task_id values

    mat = Matrix(select(wide, Not(:bee_id)))
    return mat, bee_ids, task_ids
end
```

```{julia}
using Plots

"""
    plot_state_heatmaps(matsA, matsB, epochs; bee_ids=nothing, task_ids=nothing, clim=:auto)

matsA/matsB: Dict(epoch => Matrix)
epochs: vector like [0, 100, 500, 2000]

Produces a 2×length(epochs) grid:
- Row 1: dfA matrices
- Row 2: dfB matrices
"""
function plot_state_heatmaps(matsA::Dict{Int,<:AbstractMatrix},
                             matsB::Dict{Int,<:AbstractMatrix},
                             epochs::AbstractVector{<:Integer};
                             bee_ids=nothing,
                             task_ids=nothing,
                             clim=:auto)

    ne = length(epochs)

    # shared color limits (ignore NaNs)
    if clim === :auto
        vals = Float64[]
        for e in epochs
            append!(vals, vec(matsA[Int(e)]))
            append!(vals, vec(matsB[Int(e)]))
        end
        vals = filter(!isnan, vals)
        cmin, cmax = minimum(vals), maximum(vals)
    else
        cmin, cmax = clim
    end

    # axis ticks (optional)
    xticks = task_ids === nothing ? :auto : (1:length(task_ids), string.(task_ids))
    yticks = bee_ids  === nothing ? :auto : (1:length(bee_ids),  string.(bee_ids))

    ps = Plot[]  # collect subplots

    for (col, e_) in enumerate(epochs)
        e = Int(e_)

        p1 = heatmap(matsA[e];
            title = "dfA · epoch $e",
            xlabel = (col == ceil(Int, ne/2) ? "task_id" : ""),
            ylabel = (col == 1 ? "bee_id" : ""),
            aspect_ratio = 1,
            clim = (cmin, cmax),
            xticks = xticks,
            yticks = yticks,
            colorbar = (col == ne)  # show a colorbar only on last column
        )

        p2 = heatmap(matsB[e];
            title = "dfB · epoch $e",
            xlabel = (col == ceil(Int, ne/2) ? "task_id" : ""),
            ylabel = (col == 1 ? "bee_id" : ""),
            aspect_ratio = 1,
            clim = (cmin, cmax),
            xticks = xticks,
            yticks = yticks,
            colorbar = (col == ne)
        )

        push!(ps, p1, p2)
    end

    plot(ps...; layout=(2, ne), size=(350*ne, 700), margin=5Plots.mm)
end
```
